description: Returns the verses that match a search of the text, in Bible order, each with its reference, link and text; 10 per page by default (limit 1-25, and nextOffset continues). English by default; language=hebrew|greek|aramaic searches the original with vowel points and accents ignored. Every word must be in the verse; \"quoted phrase\" matches exact order; a trailing * matches word endings (lov*); English words are matched as written, without stemming. Narrow with book, testament (tanakh|new testament|apocrypha) or edition. Use when the user searches for words or phrases in the text itself.

book.description: restrict to one book, e.g. Isaiah

edition.description: which text, e.g. septuagint, onkelos, pseudo-jonathan, jonathan, hebrew-nt, hebrew or greek

language.description: which text is searched: english, hebrew, greek or aramaic

limit.description: how many results to return (1-25, default 10)

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

offset.description: how many results to skip; the previous answer's nextOffset is where its page ended

query.description: the words or "quoted phrase" to find; a trailing * matches word endings (lov*)

name: search_text
title: Search the text
